text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I saw Victoire Pisa and Tosen Jordan dancing under the overpass.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez, this is way too hard!
It's literally impossible!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Jordan.
Why don't we take a short break for now?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer.
Right now, I'm just helping Jordan
with her dance lessons.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, it's trending on social media.
Learning the choreography of a professional dancer is such a wonderful challenge, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"They were all extremely difficult moves, but
Ms. Jordan never gave up,
trying again and again—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Pisa, that's embarrassing...
I was just frustrated that I couldn't do it at all,
so I guess I got carried away.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I started this thinking it'd look so cool if I pulled off something this insanely hard, but doing it in a single day is totally impossible.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it is what it is. We were only
lightheartedly planning to post it on Umastagram anyway."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I can take it from here on my own.
Thanks, Pisa. For keeping me company."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you for your concern.
But I assure you, I'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I just want to stand by the side of someone
who is truly trying their hardest. That's all."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Well yeah, but what do we get out of it?
Doesn't seem like they can give us much of a reward."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"No, I don't ask for anything in return
for helping a friend. Besides—"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If we can make a great dance video,
I'm sure everyone who sees it will want to
try dancing too.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
People connecting with each other
through dance like that...
Don't you think that's truly wonderful?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Eh, who knows... I doubt I have
that kind of influence, anyway."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"No, don't say that!
Earnest feelings speak louder than anything else.
I'm sure someone will follow in your footsteps."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, I'll do it.
It'd be uncool to back out after you said all that.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-san...
You really are such a wonderful person.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah, jeez! Cut that out already...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Man, what should I do?
Doing the same old training doesn't feel like it'll change anything.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Trainer, how do you think
I should go about learning this difficult dance?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the looks of it, this dance is difficult for two reasons:
the complex choreography and the fast tempo of the song. In that case—
choice_data_list: Why not try being the one who teaches for a change?
Why don't we speed up the song even more!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real?
I don't really think I'm cut out for teaching though.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
However, they often say it helps you reflect on yourself.
Why not give it a try, Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —Yes, yes, yes! That's it, Pisa, perfect!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-san had wonderful footwork too!
With this, we can finish up the video.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, about that.
Can I ask you one more favor?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Later on, Tosen Jordan and Victoire Pisa's masterfully synchronized dance went massively viral.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"If you get used to the fast tempo, the original song will be a breeze"?
Easy for you to say when it's not your problem~

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's all right, Jordan-san.
I'll be right there with you.
We'll definitely see this through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... D-Did it work...?
I think we just did it, Pisa!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We did it, Jordan-san!
Taking on a huge wall with someone else makes it possible to overcome...
I truly felt that today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result of tenaciously sticking with her practice,
Victoire Pisa acquired
frighteningly sharp dance moves.
